description: The purpose of this API is to create the Detailed Sales Register Report of a company. Part of the Sales Register Detailed APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 20. Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Optional.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: date. Optional.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint). Optional.
